ideas.title: Investigation into Child Care Fraud in Federally Funded Programs
ideas.description: This story would investigate the child care fraud in federally funded programs, including the inefficiencies and potential fraud in Mississippi's child care programs
questions: What is the extent of child care fraud in federally funded programs?
How can stronger oversight prevent fraud in these programs?
ideas.insight: The investigation into child care fraud in federally funded programs could reveal a larger issue with the handling of federal funds and the need for stronger oversight
